# Azure DevOps Git

`azure-devops-git` · openapi · version `7.1` · **published** · readiness `reviewed_publication_user_test_required`

Connect Azure DevOps Services Git repositories (dev.azure.com REST 7.1) with a personal access token. Lists your repositories and reads files at a ref for Ragentic's Repository manifests. Independent connector for Azure DevOps. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
